name: The Mess (Central Cafeteria)
hours: Breakfast in the Morning slot, lunch at Midday, dinner in the Evening; meal plan included for Rare and Spectral, 4 cr a meal for Commons students who do not eat at Mama's.
sight: A vaulted hall of long tables under hanging dorm banners, loud as a railway station. The serving line steams with rice, grilled fish, noodles and something the menu calls 'Chef's Gamble'. Seating is unofficially by collar: white-and-gold-edged on the mezzanine, blue in the middle, a scatter of plain grey near the doors — red, gold and black jackets mixed at every table. Trays clatter, someone is shuffling at every table, and the smell of frying garlic gets into your clothes.
things: Eat (restores energy; skipping meals has consequences)
Choose where to sit — every table is a statement
Try the Chef's Gamble and see what you get
Read the daily menu board and the rulings question someone always scrawls under it
Overhear three tables of gossip at once
Notice who eats alone, who eats nothing, who pockets bread rolls
Play a lunch-break game with dessert as the ante
Carry a tray up to the mezzanine uninvited and see what happens
secret: Social map of the school at a glance. Livvie comes for the free tea and takes the bread rolls; noticing and not embarrassing her is an early route key. Jessica holds a mezzanine table and expects to be joined properly. D27+: '{H}' eats six trays one day and nothing for three, and asks the serving staff what the food 'is for'. D40: the Brant rumours start here within the hour. D61+: Marrow sometimes lunches on the mezzanine with Octavia and Gideon in plain view. D67: dinner moves forward into the late Afternoon so that everyone is in dorm by dark; the hall is half empty and people sit closer together regardless of collar.
